I can't set up a recurring 09:00 digest from here. I don't have a scheduling tool in this session, so nothing would fire tomorrow morning.

What I can do:
- **On request:** when you ask, I'll pull what's new in #coastal-team (since your last digest) and DM it to you. I'll only read the channel if you're a member of it, which I'll check first.
- **Scheduled by someone else:** if your workspace admin can set up a recurring job for this bot, I can provide the digest content for it.

Tell me if you'd like a digest now, or if you want me to keep a running list of new items for you until you ask.
